checks.result: Used the real P6-001 development session to create, submit and review an actual next_action proposal against this repository ledger. Apply returned proposal_required, retained approved status and recorded an immutable receipt; source bytes and the complete cached work projection stayed unchanged. Explicit rejection closed the trial proposal. A complete 4962-token L1 context supplied the saved checkpoint hash, the session ended normally, and Doctor then returned ok with no findings (7 sources, 2 artifacts).

checks.name: bounded_review
checks.result: Two read-only review passes identified Git registration-vs-snapshot comparison, hidden reindex before CAS, ID/key collision, unavailable-source classification, Evidence work ownership and branch-history gaps. The primary agent and Store implementer fixed these reusable causes; targeted CLI/Store cases cover them. All delegated work was finished and inspected before integration. This review is not independent E4 acceptance.

limitations: Feature-local validation and actual project self-use only. Full E4 scenarios, centralized regression/security work, benchmarks and release remain on the ledger.

Applied is a distinct reserved state. No current proposal action writes source files or marks Applied; automatic YAML writeback and post-write projection verification belong to P6-002, and work-domain dependency/evidence guards belong to P6-003. Unsupported application returns proposal_required with an approved retained proposal.

Reviewer names are caller-reported metadata. Source checks observe the current manifest and bytes but do not lock files; the future writer must repeat fingerprint comparison immediately before its write. Creating and reviewing proposals do not implicitly reindex source facts.
